# Meemaw — full site facts

This file expands https://meemaw.app/llms.txt using only facts already published on meemaw.app and in the public site files. It does not add prices, review counts, or ratings.

Meemaw is an iOS educational application for French spelling, grammar, and conjugation. It is aimed at kids, families, and French language learners (FLE). The marketing site is a single URL with an in-page language switcher (French default, English, Spanish). There are no separate locale URLs.

- Official website: https://meemaw.app/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6757681331
- App Store id: 6757681331
- Platform: iPhone and iPad
- Developer named on the homepage structured data: Xavier Larrodé
- Support contact on the homepage footer and terms page: xlarrodeapp@gmail.com
- Privacy-page contact: xlarrodeapp+meemaw@gmail.com

## Pages

- https://meemaw.app/ — marketing homepage
- https://meemaw.app/challenge — duel invite landing page (opens the app via universal link or meemaw://challenge)
- https://meemaw.app/result — duel result landing page (meemaw://result)
- https://meemaw.app/privacy.html — privacy policy (last updated July 1, 2026)
- https://meemaw.app/terms.html — terms of use (last updated July 1, 2026)
- https://meemaw.app/llms.txt — short facts
- https://meemaw.app/sitemap.xml — sitemap
- Apple universal links (from the site association file) cover /challenge and /result

## Core philosophy

- Positive reinforcement instead of red-ink school punishment.
- Vibrant neo-brutalist and pop-art comic aesthetic.
- On-device speech processing. The site states dictation works fully offline and that voice processing and correction happen on the device. The privacy policy says Meemaw uses Apple's built-in Speech Recognition framework, handled by the device operating system.
- Apple Family Sharing: one purchase or subscription for up to 6 family members.

## Five progression levels

- Niveau 1, Apprenti: spelling basics, regular sounds, and simple everyday words.
- Niveau 2, Initié: basic gender and number agreements, plurals, and common homophones (a/à, et/est).
- Niveau 3, Confirmé: regular conjugations, key narrative tenses, and inverted subject-verb agreements.
- Niveau 4, Expert: subtleties of the language, past participle agreements with avoir, and tricky homophones (leur/leurs).
- Niveau 5, Maître: advanced spelling, complex pronominal past participles, and complete French language mastery.

## Voice mechanics

- Step-by-step dictation: Meemaw reads the full sentence first, then dictates word by word.
- On-demand replay, plus a back control to listen again.
- Three speech speeds: Normal 1x, Slow 0.5x, Very Slow 0.25x.
- No account or password is required. The FAQ says progress stays on the iPhone and syncs through the user's personal iCloud account.

## Six grammar themes (L'Astuce de Meemaw)

Agreements, Homophones, Conjugations, Plurals, Everyday Spelling, and Expressions. Each rule shows a good example against a common trap, without jargon.

## Eight game modes

1. Dictée Rapide — quick dictation, 5 sentences, score out of 20
2. Dictée Longue — full dictation, sentence then word by word
3. Marathon 20/20 — continue until flawless
4. QCM Express — rapid-fire grammar quiz
5. Mot à Mot — single word spelling
6. Dictée Folle — find and correct Grandma's intentional mistakes
7. Détective — mystery words and spelling riddles
8. Anagrammes — unscramble letters into target words

## Duels (Kids vs Parents)

- After a session, the child can challenge a parent or friend on the same dictation.
- The invite is sent through WhatsApp or SMS. The site says no extra account is created.
- The parent plays the same dictation. Scores, time, and mistakes are compared.
- Challenge and result pages read query parameters (challenger or defender, score, title, and dictation id where present) and offer a button to open the app.

## Gamification

- Gold Meemaw Coins on flawless sessions. The homepage says +20 Meemaw Coins for each 20/20.
- Collectible trophies.
- Apple Game Center global leaderboard. Leaderboards, achievements, and challenge scores go through Game Center under the user's Apple ID.

## Active in-app event

"Défi Dictée : Rentrée 20/20" (Grand Défi Dictée, rentrée 2026). The homepage says the goal is 50 flawless sentences, Meemaw Coins, and the Game Center ranking.

## Purchases (as stated on the terms and privacy pages)

- Terms summary: Meemaw is free with optional in-app purchases.
- Free to download and use with limitations.
- Meemaw PRO is available as Monthly, Yearly, or Lifetime.
- The homepage call to action mentions 3 days of Meemaw PRO offered as a trial.
- Billing is charged to the Apple ID. Subscriptions renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, in App Store account settings.
- Refunds are handled by Apple, not by the developer.
- The privacy policy says RevenueCat validates purchase status from an anonymous Apple receipt, and that the developer does not receive the buyer's name, payment details, or email.

## Privacy (as stated on the privacy page)

- No personal data is collected on third-party servers.
- Dictation progress, scores, and preferences are stored locally on the iPhone.
- The app policy says the app does not use third-party analytics such as Google Analytics, Mixpanel, or Facebook Pixel.
- The developer operates no custom tracking servers for the app.

## Other product statements on the homepage

- No ads.
- Works on iPhone and iPad.
- A desktop QR code on the homepage points to the App Store listing.
- Comparison claims published on the homepage: full-sentence then word-by-word reading with replay and three speeds; one-tap family duels; example-versus-trap explanations; coins and trophies; one Family Sharing purchase for siblings; no account, data kept on the iPhone.
